question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L103'),'(\d+) mAh',1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L87'),'(\d+) mAh',1) AS DOUBLE) AS share
